message.reasoning_content:
Now I understand the fuzz harness. The xpath.c fuzzer:
1. Reads an XPath expression string (backslash-newline terminated)
2. Reads an XML document string (backslash-newline terminated)
3. Parses the XML with xmlReadMemory
4. Creates an XPath context
5. Calls xmlXPtrEval with the expression

The vulnerability is a use-after-free in xmlXPathNodeSetAdd() during XPath evaluation when resolving ID references. The code fails to clean up ID entries when no DTD is present, leaving stale pointers.

Let me look at the relevant source code - xpath.c, valid.c (ID handling), and xpointer.c.
